text:
Vikram Shah: Heads-up — trying to lock the canary plan for the new open-model batch (Astra-7b, Marlin-13b-tilt). Need final owners for: licensing sign-off, perf profile, and canary window. Timeline: canary start Wed 10:00 PT. Who's taking what?

Maria Chen: I can own perf + canary dashboards. Will run 95p latency runs, token-cost sweep, and a small quality smoke eval. Report by Tue EOD.

Jordan Lee: I can own rollout scripts + infra (autoscale, traffic-shift). Need CR review on my rollout playbook: <https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1234|PR#1234>.

Sadaf Ibrahim: Legal here — I need the finalized license text from intake before we flip traffic. @catalog-bot can you attach the license artifacts for Astra & Marlin? Also, does Marlin require an MPN/third-party CLA?

catalog-bot: Attached: astra-7b-license.pdf, marlin-13b-tilt-license-draft.pdf (uploaded to /catalog/licenses).

LegalBot: License scan results: Astra-7b -> permissive (OK). Marlin-13b-tilt -> third-party CLA flagged (pending). See /catalog/licenses/marlin-13b-tilt-license-draft.pdf.

Maria Chen: Perf notes from quick local runs: Astra-7b 95p latency ~120ms on p4d instance. Marlin quantized (8-bit) shows ~40% token-cost savings but ~2-3ms extra latency per token. I'll produce a short table in the dashboard.

Vikram Shah: Proposed owners: perf=Maria, infra=Jordan, legal=Sadaf, catalog-ingest=Ezra. @Ezra Patel can you confirm manifest + embedding shape are ready?

Ezra Patel: Confirming manifest uploaded (s3://catalog/manifests/marlin-13b-tilt.json). Quick snag: Astra embeddings were float32 vs our float16 expectation — ingest pipeline needs a conversion step. Filing tiny PR to fix ingest. ETA tonight.

Jordan Lee: CR ping @Vikram Shah @Maria Chen on <https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1234|PR#1234>. Also we need to reserve dedicated capacity for Marlin canary — ops needs a commit id to hold GPUs. @eng-infra /ops: any objections?

Sadaf Ibrahim: Legal gate: Marlin's CLA must be cleared before the 10:00 Wed start. I've emailed vendor contact (vendor@example.com) for signature — will update once confirmed. If not cleared, we must fallback to Astra for the canary.

Vikram Shah: Good. If Marlin license pending at Wed 08:00 PT -> fallback to Astra. Can everyone post a go/no-go checklist by Tue 09:00 PT so I can assemble the final schedule?

Maria Chen: Will drop perf report + small quality eval (bleu/rouge-ish smoke) by Tue 19:00 PT. Dashboard link will be in the canary folder.

Jordan Lee: I'll add the ramp schedule to the rollout doc and include the traffic-shift script. Planning to ramp: 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% over ~30m. Script (draft):

```
# traffic ramp (example)
ramp --model marlin-13b-tilt --steps 1,10,50,100 --step-duration 600
```

Jordan Lee: Tagging owners in the doc. :calendar:

Ezra Patel: Ingest PR: <https://github.com/redwood/catalog/pull/789|PR#789> — converts Astra embeddings to float16 and validates shapes. I'll also add a small schema check to prevent regressions.

Vikram Shah: Thanks all. Quick summary for next steps: (1) Sadaf — license clearance for Marlin (gate), (2) Maria — perf + quality report, (3) Jordan — rollout CR + ops reservation, (4) Ezra — ingest fix merged. If all green, canary starts Wed 10:00 PT. Please flag blockers ASAP. :thumbsup:
